name: Scho pryhovue misto
source:
Marina arrives in a quiet provincial town where her best friend mysteriously disappeared. But instead of answers, she finds silence, secrets, and strangers who all seem to be hiding something.

What happened here? What are these strange murders haunting the town? And how far is Marina willing to go to uncover the truth?

The Secrets of the Town is an atmospheric visual novel with mystery and otome elements. Explore, investigate, and connect with the people around you — some of whom may become more than just allies...
translation:
玛丽娜抵达一个安静的省级城镇，她最好的朋友在那里神秘失踪。但她没有找到答案，而是发现了沉默、秘密和陌生人，他们似乎都在隐藏着什么。

这里发生了什么？小镇上发生的这些奇怪的谋杀案到底是什么？玛丽娜愿意为揭露真相付出多大的努力？

《小镇的秘密》是一部充满悬疑和乙女元素的大气视觉小说。探索、调查并与你周围的人建立联系——其中一些人可能不仅仅是盟友……
